fieldMarks: White morph: all white with black wingtips and pink-orange bill and legs.
Blue morph: gray-brown body and wings with a white head.
Immatures are grayer (white morph) or mostly dark brown (blue morph).
Greater (larger, eastern Canada) and lesser forms are recognised; morphs interbreed.
behavior: Walks to feed on land or in shallow water, eating roots, leaves and seeds of grasses and sedges, and waste grain in winter fields.
Migrates long distances in flocks, sometimes at high altitude, using traditional stopovers.
habitat: Breeds on Arctic tundra near water; winters in coastal marshes, estuaries, freshwater marshes and farmland.
range: Breeds in Alaska and Arctic Canada; winters across the Plains, Gulf Coast, Atlantic coast and elsewhere in the US.
